basic_profile.bio: Hailing from Zurich, Switzerland, I'm a 38-year-old software engineer with a penchant for all things horror. I live with my partner and our two cats. My work in tech allows me flexible hours, but I usually browse Reddit in the evenings, especially when I'm winding down. I'm an avid fan of horror films and series, but I also enjoy deep dives into niche subreddits about workplace dynamics and tech trading. I dislike overly commercialized content and anything that feels inauthentic. I often spend my weekends hiking in the Swiss Alps or experimenting with new vegan recipes.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Master's in Computer Science from ETH Zurich and have worked in the tech industry for over 15 years. My expertise extends into AI and machine learning, but horror media is a passion project that I've pursued through self-teaching, attending workshops, and engaging with the horror community online. I've also contributed to a few indie horror game projects.
behavioral_pattern.relationship_with_community_policies: strict, with a high level of policy awareness. I believe in maintaining the integrity of discussions and often report off-topic or harmful content. I am very familiar with both subreddit-specific and site-wide rules.
